title: Chris's bands, attitude and music at home
summary: Chris played with everyone, led the Chris Kelly band, showed up weak players, and kept his music close and did not practice at home.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players
